messages:
anna_sec: FYI image-scan-bot flagged a couple of images from yesterday's CI build. One image shows signature verification failure + high-severity CVE in system libs. :rotating_light:
image-scan-bot: scan report for redwood/service-api:2026-03-19 - severity: HIGH; CVEs: CVE-2026-1234 (libcurl), CVE-2025-9876 (openssl). signature: INVALID (key id not found)
tom_ops: Ack. Which repo/job? can we quarantine the image and stop deploys? @jenna_sre
anna_sec: build job: ci/service-api/main -> image tag above. Quarantine yes, but note the verify failure looks like KMS key rotation mismatch rather than tamper.
jenna_sre: I can't run quarantine without the image-quarantine RBAC role. I requested it last month and it expired. @kyle_engineer do you have a script?
kyle_engineer: I have a small helper. Command: `infractl images quarantine --image redwood/service-api:2026-03-19 --reason "vuln+sig-fail"`
jenna_sre: trying now... getting 403 from infractl: missing iam.allow.image_quarantine permission.
luis_infra: We're in the middle of a KMS key rotation for signing keys. Looks like the key alias changed and the verifier list hasn't been updated in the verifier service. That'll make old signatures appear invalid until we add the previous key id to the verifier or re-sign images.
anna_sec: timeline? Do we know if it's just the verifier missing the old key or did CI sign with a new key prematurely?
luis_infra: CI pulled the new signing key yesterday morning. The verifier configuration is staged but not rolled to all regions; one region is still on the previous config which expects the old key id. Edge-case ordering.
tom_ops: So two separate problems: a real CVE in the image AND signature mismatch due to key rotation ordering. We should treat the image as untrusted until both are resolved. Quarantine + block deploys for that tag.
jenna_sre: I've filed the quarantine request manually via the admin console and flagged the deploy pipeline to stop for that tag. Request ID: Q-2026-138.
kyle_engineer: I'll open a short-lived allow for infractl so SRE can run bulk quarantine for any sibling tags (expires in 2h).
anna_sec: For the CVE: are we blocked on a patch from upstream or can we rebuild with a patched base?
luis_infra: libcurl openssl CVEs — upstream has fixes in their next patch release. We can rebase onto our pinned base (alpine:3.18-patch) that includes the fixes and rebuild. That will produce a new signature though; need to coordinate re-signing.
jenna_sre: Action list: 1) Quarantine existing tag (done) 2) Block deploys (done) 3) Trigger rebuild on patched base (kyle) 4) Update verifier config to include previous key id / confirm KMS rotation order (luis) 5) Notify affected customers if any in dedicated clusters (anna)
tom_ops: I'll patch the deploy gating rules to block that tag pattern until CI job finished and re-signed images are available.
kyle_engineer: Kicking off a rebuild now with patched base, will push a new tag redwood/service-api:2026-03-19-patch1 and ping when ready. ETA ~25m.
luis_infra: Rolling verifier config to all regions now. If anyone sees more INVALID signatures after ~5m ping here.
anna_sec: I'll draft a short status note for customer-facing channels if any dedicated customers pulled that tag in the last 48h. Also adding this incident to the tracker.
jenna_sre: rebuild image pushed and signed. New tag: redwood/service-api:2026-03-19-patch1. Doing smoke tests.
kyle_engineer: smoke looks good, no CVE hits in SBOM scan.
image-scan-bot: scan report for redwood/service-api:2026-03-19-patch1 - severity: LOW; CVEs: none; signature: VALID (key id: key-2026-rotated)
anna_sec: Great. Can we auto-unquarantine the new tag and update any customers who received the quarantined tag?
jenna_sre: Unquarantine request submitted for the new tag. We should NOT auto-unquarantine the old tag.
luis_infra: verifier roll completed. We added previous key id to verifier allowlist for a short grace period; we'll remove after 72h.
anna_sec: Post-incident: add a CI guard to ensure verifier config roll is applied before signing with new key, and add an SBOM check to fail builds if known-high CVEs are present. Will open follow-ups.
tom_ops: Thanks everyone. Creating a postmortem stub and linking the quarantine request + verifier change.
anna_sec: Closing here once postmortem created. :thumbsup:
